svg.aria-label: All writes go to the leader. The leader streams its change log to one synchronous follower and to asynchronous followers. Reads can be served by followers.
svg.title: All writes go to the leader. The leader streams its change log to one synchronous follower and to asynchronous followers. Reads can be served by followers.
svg.text: One synchronous follower = every committed write exists on 2 machines.
